messages.content: I’ll commit a regulation-heavy day-ahead book with some dispatch headroom, a small overnight charge, and an evening discharge, then monitor conditions through the operating day. The dry run is feasible and projects about $7,922 profit; actual settlement will depend on real-time prices and deployments.

Overnight RegDn deployment was much higher than forecast, filling the battery to 200 MWh. The controller intervened, and the resulting reserve shortfalls were excused. I’ll schedule the available 10 MW discharge headroom to restore charging room; the day-ahead AS awards remain fixed.

RegUp deployment has since drawn SoC down to 51.91 MWh. I’ll replace the remaining evening discharges with maximum permitted charging to improve reserve backing and reduce the risk of an end-of-day SoC shortfall.
